policy.nature_of_guarantees: Discrete single slots SA1 and SA4 carry finite-sample certified unconditional exact coverage and Type-I upper-bound proofs over Delta_3 under [0,1] sample-path bounding; continuous resampling slots SA2, SA3 and joint 4-slot behavior are verified by finite-matrix Monte Carlo calibration on tested DGPs, not an all-distribution non-asymptotic theorem.
